steps: You tell the crew what was in the memory. Now knowing Allie is Taffett, you set out to find White Cat's secret room. After trekking through a mine crawling with Desert Scorpions, you find Hazana guarding the door...
Right. Allie traded her soul with me last night so I could help her recover the memories the Monolith took.
I asked Vita for a trial of the Monolith Melody,==W== and we fell asleep right here.==W==
But ... that dream was long. Even longer than Iris's.
So Allie is the "Taffett" Kasimira's looking for...==W==
She erased her own memories and lived a completely different life to stay with those kids...==W== Who would have imagined?
But then...==W== Is this woman sleeping next to me the mother of the orphanage, or a White Cat soldier?
Morning, Vita.==W== You don't usually greet me. Something's up?
Yes. There is something I wish to discuss with you in private, Tyrant.
Oh, back in your white room again. You seem to like this place.
Not particularly. It is simply empty, which saves on processing power. I can simulate a different environment if you prefer. Shall I?
No, it's fine.==W== What did you want to discuss?
Last night, I gave you another trial of the Monolith Melody. You and Miss Allie dreamed her lost memories. Because the trial includes a memory wipe, she will forget everything when she wakes.
But your magic immunity cancels the wipe. You will remember everything.
You might be wondering: if you are immune to magic, how did you dream those memories at all? Isn't the dream itself magic?
Simple. The Monolith Melody isn't magic. It is a special power.
Wait, you knew?==W== I thought I was the only one==W== who figured out I'd keep the memories.
You underestimate me. As your Priest, I accounted for that.==W== And since you've been so proactive in completing your missions lately, a small bonus won't hurt.
Besides, don't you think the trial version is more useful to you than the full version?
In the full version, no one forgets what they recover. But in the trial, I'm the only one who remembers.
So if I'm the only one with the memories, I get to decide what they mean. Right?
Exactly. As expected of Tyrant. You already knew.
Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.
Now you can use the present to rewrite what everyone thinks is the past, and shape their futures.
Thanks, Vita. You're always trying to give me the upper hand.
But you never take my advice. Did I miscalculate something?
Your logic is sound, and I know you mean well. I just don't want to be someone who calculates every move.
I understand. What kind of person do you wish to be, then?
I'm not sure yet.==W== Probably someone who trusts and supports ==SEX3== friends as we move forward together.
Understood. I'll make a note of it. Please excuse me.
Phew. Vita's always making suggestions like that.==W== If I'd listened to her from the start, I'd have turned into some mastermind plotting schemes 24/7.
Yawn... I slept wonderfully.==W== Good morning, ==W====PLAYER_NAME==. Waking up all on your own like a good kid.==W== You're an early bird today.
Hey, hey, Allie! Are you still half asleep?!
... Huh?==W== Oh, sorry! I'm a mess...==W== I had a wonderful dream last night, and I guess I got carried away... ♪
A wonderful dream? Mind telling me what it was about?
Oh, well...==W== Iris, Noya, and Amber were gathered around me, calling me Mom...==W== I don't remember the details.

I see.==W== The Monolith Melody worked, then.==W== You won't remember that dream yourself, though. Only I can.==W== Do you want to hear about your past first?==W== If there's anything you'd rather keep private, I can leave it out...
No need. How could a mother lie to her children?==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, please tell everyone what happened in those lost memories. Don't leave a single thing out.
10:00, Nebula Month 18th, Mirage, The Daisy Orphanage
A few hours later. I recounted Allie's lost memories of Taffett and Narida to the New Star Guild and the White Cat Troupe, with every detail.
Aunt Allie...==W== That was a terrible injury. It must have hurt.
The wound healed up fast, though, right? I remember that medicine in the basement working like magic on any injury.
Yeah. Thanks to that medicine, it didn't even leave a scar. I suppose it wasn't serious at the time.
You're amazing, Aunt Allie!==W== You and Narida took down over a hundred Sentinels and Imperial Knights.==W== All of us together could barely handle ten.
And to think Aunt Allie is ... the strongest White Cat.==W== I still can't believe it.
So that's why we stopped calling you Mom and switched to Aunt Allie.==W== The Monolith must have taken that memory when we made our wishes. Thank goodness we got it back.
Then why did the kids who came later start calling you Mom again?
Because Aunt Allie...==W== I mean, Mom, has always felt like a mother to us. We started calling her that on our own when we were little, didn't we?
By the time they stopped hunting White Cats in Emor, Mom had forgotten the taboo herself, so everyone went back to it.==W== We were the only ones still honoring that old rule.
Ah, wonderful!==W== It warms my heart to hear Iris call me Mom again.==W==
Noya, Amber, what about you two? Are you going to follow her lead?
Mom.==W== Mom,==W== Mom!==W== MOM!!==W== Haha, once you've said it, it's not that embarrassing anymore! ♪
That sounds wonderful. Thanks to you,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==, my heart gets to melt at that again.
Guys, can we focus?==W== How did we end up discussing whether to call her Mom?==W== The assassination rumors, Iris's past, the way into the secret room. Did you all forget about those?
The White Cats look grim, though.==W== I wonder what they actually think about all this history.
Taffett...==W== No, since you left that name behind, we will still call you Director Allie.==W== Thank you, and thank you, Boss, for bringing the truth to light.
So that explains where she went. Whenever my sister vanished for months out of the year, she was in Emor.
The White Cats never killed the Empress. We were never traitors. It was all lies and slander.
My sister didn't go there to surrender.==W== She went to break the chains holding us back.
We fought Desert Scorpions and Imperial Guards. We lost people every single day.==P====W== None of us knew why that Monolith mattered.==P====W== We threw our lives away out of blind honor and duty.

Captain Narida was the only White Cat in Mirage who had actually met the Empress.==P====W== The rest of us, myself included, only understood the basic concept of being her personal guard.==P====W== Looking back, Captain Narida must have realized it then,==P====W== that if we kept fighting like that, we would all die for a cause none of us understood.
My sister always wore a smile.==W== But so many nights I would catch her sitting alone on the dunes, staring at that Monolith until dawn.
She was desperate for a way to save us.==W== That explains why she left the desert to find Mom,==W== or Taffett back then.
At first I figured Captain Narida was trying to uncover the truth about the Empress's death and clear our name.
I thought if she recruited you, our fighting power would be secured.
But she came back from one of those trips looking like a massive weight had been lifted.
She stopped staring out at the Monolith all night. Instead, she started locking herself in the secret room to study a signed red Soul Stone.
Back then, I assumed she had finally found a lead on Taffett...
I never imagined she would vanish alongside the Monolith.
Because ... Her Majesty ordered every White Cat except you to seal off the Monolith in Mirage.==W== No one's allowed in.
She sealed the Monolith as ordered and saved the rest of us in the process.==W== She put an end to those endless battles we never understood.
That's when Mirage became what it is today. Everyone plays along in this massive performance.==W== It sounds absurd, but no one's died fighting since.
Oh, I get it!==W== Amber, your pistols. When Director Allie told Narida to take the weapons away, Narida must have stashed them in the basement.==W== And then you found them!
I think ...==W== my sister wanted to leave those pistols as a keepsake for Mom. Even if Mom never knew they were there.
Thank you, Boss.==W== It feels like a weight I've carried for years has finally lifted.
Well then, time to keep our promise. We'll take you to the White Cats' secret room.
But didn't you say only Narida or Taffett could open that door?==W== Allie's memories didn't seem to hold the password you mentioned.
We already have it.==W== The password is the song==W== Captain Narida used to hum.
11:00, Nebula Month 18th, Mirage, Crystal Diamond Mine
Wow, is this the mine shaft? Incredible! It feels like a real adventure!
Heh heh heh...==W== Every time I descend underground into the abyss's darkness, my dark power surges!==W== ... Probably.
Yeah! Let me breathe in some of that dark power too!==W== Inhales...==W== Pffft!
No!==W== You're not allowed to breathe! All the dark power down here is mine!
Come to think of it, those crystal diamonds the Imperial Guard used to pay us came from places like this.
A shaft this deep... How did they even dig it?==W== You can handle dirt and rock with tools, but they must have hit massive, unbreakable boulders.
That wouldn't work. The earth around the shaft isn't stable enough. An uncontrolled explosion could easily cause a cave-in.
So the old miners used a method called heat and quench.
Heat and quench? How does that work?
First, you get someone with fire magic to superheat the rock.==W== Then someone with water magic douses it to cool it instantly.
The sudden shock makes the stone crack on its own.==W== After that, you drive wedges into the cracks to split it apart.
Fascinating. Miners are clever. I need to write this down.
Haha, it's not like I figured it out myself.==W== An old miner who used to work here told me, I'm just passing the knowledge along.
We should be moving faster.==W== Why does this feel like a school trip? Are we okay taking it this easy?
Wait, did I say that out loud?
Hehe.==W== Nope. But I can tell what you're thinking. You're an open book,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME==.
Is that some kind of mom superpower?==W== No, impossible.==W== Still, that's amazing ...==W== and a little terrifying.
See? Everyone is on high alert.==W== Taking it easy earlier was their way to wind down before a fight.
True. You have everyone figured out, Allie.
Hold it, Boss. That's far enough for you lot.
And you White Cats!==W== You cave this tunnel in, and you'll regret it.
Huh? We didn't do anything wrong! You're the ones conning Trekkers into forced labor.
Forced labor? We sign contracts. Our terms are better than United Harvest!==W== What's the matter, you White Cats itching to blow something up again?
Easy, Myrsha. We aren't here to wreck the mine.
We want to open the White Cats' secret room. We need to find the missing Monolith.
Haha! Perfect.==W== We had no clue how to open that room. You saved us the trouble.
...==W== And what do the Desert Scorpions want with it?
Isn't it obvious?==W== This is our mine now. Everything inside the mine belongs to us. That includes the secret room.
Nonsense.==W== Let's settle this with a duel. Desert rules.
A duel?==W== Hahaha!==W== Bring it on!==W==
Whoa! Pffft! What the hell? A sandstorm inside a mine?
Cough... Damn it, we're cut off. We can't reach Boss.
Hehehe... You should have taken our deal, Boss. Now you pay the price.
... But still, I'm not a monster. You want a duel? Fine. Since you want the room, you're fighting me.
You win, the room is yours. You lose, you join the Desert Scorpions.
We're paying her back for that assassination in Philae right here.
